extracted.name: Tomato Cucumber Onion Salad
extracted.description: This tomato, cucumber, and red onion salad is tossed in an easy red wine vinegar and olive oil dressing for a bright, crunchy, colorful summer salad.
instruction_lines: Toss together cucumber, tomato, olive oil, red wine vinegar, red onion, and white pepper in a large serving bowl; season with salt. Refrigerate until slightly chilled, 10 to 15 minutes.
